collections.name: Radiant Ripples
collections.intro: Fifteen details from Radiant Ripples, a red and orange painting crossed by turquoise currents. Up close, rows of small pale tiles drift through the warm ground, and a yellow burst breaks open near the heart of the panel.

collections.name: Radiant Currents
collections.intro: Orange fills every frame here, rippled like heat rising off a summer road. Cream-toothed rings, deep blue chains and small black dots turn each detail into something between a clock face and a map.

collections.name: Spiral Waves
collections.intro: Cool blues meet sudden flashes of lemon yellow. The details move between quiet indigo surfaces, pale bands curving like domes, and a yellow vortex that pulls the whole painting toward its center.

collections.name: Radiant Echoes
collections.intro: A painting built entirely from reds, from scarlet to coral to raspberry. Its details are full of ladders, rungs and concentric arcs, white geometry glowing through a warm, marbled ground.

collections.name: Calming Ripples
collections.intro: Wide rings of blue spread across this painting, interrupted by bright orange bursts and magenta shadows. The details read like slow water: arcs, drips and streaks that stay calm even where the color flares.

collections.name: Resonant Currents
collections.intro: Greens of every kind, from moss to emerald, run through this painting alongside teal, blue and touches of berry. The details hold garden-like textures, pale blocks and rings that echo outward.

collections.name: Nature's Pulse
collections.intro: The most botanical painting of the series, almost entirely lime, olive and chartreuse. Up close it turns into leaves, lattices and sweeping white arcs, like sunlight falling through a canopy.

collections.name: Dynamic Circles
collections.intro: Deep blue, aqua and flashes of magenta, cut by luminous white rings. The details are full of motion: orbits, arches and bands of light that never quite sit still.

collections.name: Organized Chaos
collections.intro: Indigo, violet and white, broken by splashes of lime and mustard. The details pile up pale tiles, petals and paths, a crowded surface that somehow keeps its order.

collections.name: Fiery Bang!
collections.intro: Pure heat in red, orange, pink and honey yellow. The details range from tight checkerboards of light to wide glowing arches, each taken from a painting that seems to burst outward from its center.
